messages:
Sophie Lin: quick idea: surface an \"Explain SLO Decision\" affordance in the console next to each alertable SLO. show which rule fired, why notify was suppressed (if it was), and an estimated notify fanout + quota impact. would cut down paging noise debug.

Ethan Brooks: love that. two quick constraints: 1) we must not compute heavy joins on page render; 2) avoid leaking tenant ids in cached front-end payloads.

Noah Rivera: backend approach: precompute a compact decision-summary proto per-route (1m rollup). includes last_violation_bucket, suppression_reason, notify_candidates_count, cost_estimate_tokens. cheap to fetch.

Zara Khan: UX: show compact pill on card: \"explained\" icon. click expands pane with timeline + quick bullet that says: \"Last notify suppressed by: dedupe (window 5m)\". allow copy of the raw decision graph for SRE.

Sophie Lin: example internal API I sketched for the summary:

```http
GET /internal/console/v1/slo/rt_998/decision-summary
200 OK
{
  "slo_id": "rt_998",
  "current_threshold": "p99<150ms",
  "last_violation_bucket": "2025-03-03T10:44:00Z",
  "suppression": "dedupe(window=300s)",
  "notify_candidates": "6",
  "est_token_cost": "~120 tokens",
  "active_routing_policy": "tier-default -> fallback-tier-lowcost"
}
```

Ethan Brooks: question: where does the notify_candidates number come from? naive approach scans notify-state table at read time which is expensive. better: maintain incremental notify_count in aggregator job.

Noah Rivera: yep. the aggregator (per-1m) will materialize notify_candidates. for expand view we can also attach a tiny sample of matching alerts (ids only) to avoid full event scans.

Zara Khan: rollout plan idea: feature flag + internal tenant whitelist. start with console-users group + internal ops. hide cost estimates per tenant unless allowed.

Sophie Lin: privacy/compliance: must allow tenant opt-out and strip tenant identifiers from cached summaries. add to checklist.

ci-bot: pipeline triggered: feature/decision-summary -> test -> canary(5%) scheduled 1745610030

Ethan Brooks: one more thought: show a small telemetry sparkline (violations per hour) in the expanded pane to give quick signal of flapping vs one-off. keep it 7d window.

Noah Rivera: implementation note: store 7d histogram in summary proto (7 ints) so expand doesn't hit TSDB. cheap and predictable.

Zara Khan: copy for the panel CTA: \"Explain decision\" -> panel header: \"Why did this alert (not) page?\" -> bullets: rule, suppression, routing, est. fanout, quick sample.

Sophie Lin: action items: Ethan spike aggregator counter + API (E), Noah implement summary proto + storage (N), Zara craft copy + mock (Z). I'll own rollout gating & checklist.

Ethan Brooks: starting spike, will post perf numbers.

Noah Rivera: adding proto to schema repo. will include opt-out flag.

Zara Khan: putting mock in figma and will ping for review.

ci-bot: canary started at 1745610055

Sophie Lin: thanks team. keep it tight for canary, avoid PII in payloads. ping here for any blockers.

Ethan Brooks: ack.

Noah Rivera: ack.

Zara Khan: ack :white_check_mark:
